findings.passage: He is working to protect our right to free and fair elections by fighting to finally end the practice of gerrymandering in North Carolina and oppose efforts to limit access to voting.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, undated (date is the page fetch date, not the writing date). General statement on voting access; names no ID rule. Page is written in the third person about the candidate.
subjects: opposes efforts to limit access to voting

findings.note: Listed as a co-sponsor of House Bill 691, Voter Protection and Reliance Act (amends chapter 163 sections on election protests and results). It is not an ID bill. Last action: referred to House Rules on 4/3/2025.
